name: Red Lake
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from 1971/1990 MNRF transect surveys (years from the LIO bathymetry index; contour feature dates are null in LIO). No depth soundings exist for this lake - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 48.8 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour (74.3% of water cells at >=0.4). Cool-regime lake; cisco, walleye, northern pike in the ARA community. Secchi 1.2 m (ARA).
